changelogs.1.1.1:
**Fixed:**
- Trim editor playing through the Windows default device instead of the selected headphones
- Replays and microphone using the wrong device on setups with multiple audio devices

**Added:**
- Audio Devices section in Settings to manually choose your microphone and headphones, saved automatically
- Auto option shows which device Parrot Replay detected

**Changed:**
- Improved automatic device detection to prefer headsets and microphones over controller speakers and virtual audio devices
